title: Neon Punk Spray Painter
description: A young woman with a tall green and pink spiked mohawk wears a black leather jacket covered in dripping neon green horse silhouettes. She smiles while actively spraying bright green paint from a can, surrounded by glowing translucent green ghost horses against a dark background with vibrant pink and yellow light beams.
prompt: A rebellious young woman with a tall spiky green and pink mohawk, wearing a black leather jacket covered in dripping neon green horse silhouettes, smiles as she sprays bright green paint from a spray can. Translucent glowing green ghost horses float around her in dynamic poses against a dark background with dramatic pink and yellow light beams cutting through the scene, paint drips and splatters visible, vibrant cyberpunk aesthetic
